title: Dojo training trial
description: One hand-authored dojo trial in data/trials/<id>.json (R7, YOK-105). The player gets exactly 3 attempts; landing the goal within them levels the trial's special. The goal is an ordered list of steps, each one thing the fight can observe (a Hit, Throw or block event, the dummy's state, the distance between the fighters), never a button or motion, so every trial is Kihon-completable (K2). Distances are gameplay units, frames are 60 Hz ticks.

special.description: Id of the special (kind 'special' in data/moves/) the trial levels (R7). At least one goal step must name it as its move.

prompt.description: What the dojo shows the player, in plain words (e.g. 'Hit the dummy at mid range, then anti-air its jump').

attempts.description: Fixed by R7: the special levels if the goal is landed within 3 attempts.

steps.description: Met in order within one attempt; events that match no step are ignored.

distance.description: Start distance between the fighters' centres, gameplay units (body width 120 .. max separation 1520, SimConfig).

attempt_frames.description: Ticks one attempt lasts before it counts as failed.

dummy.description: What the dummy does. idle/crouch/guard/crouch_guard hold that stance; jump jumps straight up every `every` ticks; attack plays `moves` in order (a string) every `every` ticks.

moves.description: attack only: move ids from the dummy's kit, played as a string.

every.description: jump and attack: ticks between one start and the next.

step.description: One observation. hit = the player's strike or projectile connects unblocked (Match.Hit); combo = `count` unblocked hits with the dummy never actionable between them; throw = the player's throw lands (Match.Throw, Land); block = the player blocks `count` of the dummy's hits. Kata-only inputs (motion, precision) are not allowed (K1, K2).

move.description: hit/throw: the move that connects; combo: a move that must be one of the combo's hits. Absent = any.

count.description: hit/block: how many (default 1); combo: hits in one combo (2 or more, required).

counter.description: hit only: must be a counterhit, i.e. the dummy was in a move (C7) - 'punish before it recovers'.

dummy_state.description: hit/throw: the dummy's state when it connects. landed = touched down from a jump within `landed_within` ticks. A throw cannot meet an airborne dummy (C4).

landed_within.description: Required with dummy_state 'landed', not allowed otherwise.

distance.description: hit/throw: distance between the fighters' centres when it connects, gameplay units.

motion.description: Kata only (K1): a trial must be Kihon-completable (R7, K2).

precision.description: Kata only (K1): the motion-input precision bonus cannot be asked for (R7, K2).

kata.description: Kata only (K1): a trial must be Kihon-completable (R7, K2).
